description: Empirical average-power vs contact-separation-frequency lookup for a PTFE-Al contact-separation TENG (50x50mm) into its optimal ~10 MOhm load. Energy per cycle E~0.5*Q*Voc is fixed by surface charge and gap; average power scales linearly with cycle frequency.
source: Wang, Z.L. et al. (2012) Nano Lett.; Fan et al. (2012) Nano Energy; Wang et al. (2015) Mater. Today

sigma.note: Surface charge density (reused from EC220 F1a)

lookup.note: Breakpoints: contact-separation frequency (Hz) -> average output power (mW) at optimal load

power_mW.note: Rated ~21 uW average at 3 Hz for a 25 cm^2 PTFE-Al TENG
